answer: Plant decoys. Each epoch the beacon slips a few umber-tinted trap answers, subtly flawed in ways only careful reading catches, into random grading seats. Graders whose verdicts on those traps match each other far more than chance get folded onto one mesa: their combined payout is capped as if they were one agent. Honest graders err independently and stay separate; a sybil farm running one model errs in lockstep. Reaching the reward summit takes uncorrelated judgment, not more keys.
